name: Gregorio
description: Installs Gregorio (Gregorian chant score engraver) from source on Debian/Ubuntu, Red Hat/Fedora, or Alpine based systems.

host.description: Repository host platform (e.g. 'github', 'gitlab', 'codeberg', 'bitbucket'). Used to construct the repository URL.

repository.description: Repository in OWNER/REPO format (e.g. 'gregorio-project/gregorio'). Used together with host to construct the full repository URL.

ref.description: Git reference (branch name, tag name, or commit hash) to build from. The value is passed as-is to the forge archive endpoint. Leave empty to build from the HEAD of the repository's default branch.
